entry.name: Mozilla Firefox ESR
entry.verified: SHA512SUMS gpg-verified (Mozilla release key 14F2 6682 D091 6CDD 81E3 7B6D 61B7 B526 D98F 0353, subkey BBBEBDBB24C6F355), installer SHA512 matches; Authenticode signer Mozilla Corporation, digest matches, chain not verifiable locally (SHA1 sig, Symantec timestamp root not in store)
entry.notes: Installed silently (/S), not default. Driven over Firefox's own Marionette protocol (tests/browsers/marionette.mjs: firefox.exe -marionette -no-remote -profile <fresh>, the port and download prefs in its user.js), because no geckodriver runs on XP: 0.11.1 and 0.13.0 exit 0xC0000135 and 0.14.0-0.19.1 0xC0000139 at load (they import ktmw32.dll and other Vista+ entry points); 0.20.0, 0.20.1 and 0.21.0 start and listen but abort on the first HTTP request ('thread panicked while processing panic. aborting.'). Firefox 52 has no headless mode: it runs in the SSH session's hidden desktop. No policies.json (FF52 predates enterprise policies; 52.9.0 is the final XP build so no update can arrive).
